pages.text: Loop quantum gravity quantises space: areas come in steps of $(thing)8πγℓₚ²√(j(j+1))$(). The $(item)Spin Network Loom$() weaves Planck Shards into $(item)Planck Area Tiles$(), tiles into $(item)Spin Network Nodes$(), and nodes with liquid spacetime into $(fluid)Quantum Spacetime Condensate$().

Causal set theory scatters events at random and keeps only their order: the Monte Carlo Engine sprinkles a $(item)Causal Set Seed$(). Asymptotic safety follows gravity's coupling to a fixed point instead of infinity: a node and a seed together make a $(item)Fixed-Point Lattice$().
